title: المعلقات السبع - ضبطها وألقاها د. فيصل المنصور
note: All seven Muʿallaqāt, vowelled and declaimed by the philologist Fayṣal al-Manṣūr; the most careful text-and-voice set. The jahiliyya worldview tradition does not exist yet.

title: قراءة القصائد السبع المشهورات وما أضيف إليها «المعلقات» - إلقاء: طه الأزهري
note: Ṭāhā al-Azharī reads the seven Muʿallaqāt plus al-Nābigha and al-Aʿshā, including one full video in Ibn al-Anbārī's recension. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: ✅المعلقات العشر✅
note: All ten Muʿallaqāt with the verses on screen (Muntaqā al-Dīwān). The same channel has a separate sharḥ playlist, so this one is recitation. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: المعلقات العشر بصوت د. عبد الرحمن الحمين
note: The ten Muʿallaqāt in ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Ḥumayyin's slow, clear voice. Good for repeated listening. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: المعلقات العشر
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: Abū Qays Muḥammad Rashīd declaims the ten Muʿallaqāt in al-Aṣmaʿī's recension, with the text on screen. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: المعلقات
note: Fāliḥ al-Quḍāʿ's powerful declamation of the Muʿallaqāt (Ṭarafa's has a few glosses). jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: المعلقات بصوت أسامة النهاري
note: Usāma al-Nahārī recites the Muʿallaqāt, including al-Nābigha's, in a chanted ḥudāʾ style with no instruments. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: المعلقات والشعر العربي الفصيح | مشاري راشد العفاسي
note: Mishārī al-ʿAfāsī recites edited Muʿallaqa texts (al-naṣṣ al-muḥaqqaq) plus other classical poems. The list is mixed, so it is worth filtering.

title: المعلقات العشر كاملة في مقطع واحد مع كتابة الأبيات
note: About two hours: all ten Muʿallaqāt in one video with the verses written on screen. Good for long listening. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: ديوان امرئ القيس (كامل من رواية الأصمعي والمفضل)
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: The complete dīwān of Imruʾ al-Qays (al-Aṣmaʿī and al-Mufaḍḍal recensions), declaimed by Abū Qays. His vocabulary is the core gharīb of the tafsīr shawāhid.

title: ديوان طرفة بن العبد - إلقاء مريم زكريا
note: Ṭarafa's dīwān, starting with his Muʿallaqa. His carpe-diem view of death and dahr is the outlook the Qurʾān answers. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: ديوان النابغة الذبياني - إلقاء أحمد صلاح
note: Al-Nābigha's dīwān: his Muʿallaqa and the iʿtidhāriyyāt (apology poems), read by Aḥmad Ṣalāḥ.

title: ديوان عنترة العبسي
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: ʿAntara's dīwān in al-Aṣmaʿī's recension (27 poems, the full recension), declaimed by Abū Qays.

title: ديوان لبيد بن ربيعة - إلقاء د محمود إمام
note: Labīd, the mukhaḍram poet whose verses on death and fate are often cited by the mufassirūn; read by Dr Maḥmūd Imām. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: ديوان زهير بن أبي سلمى
note: Zuhayr's dīwān, including his Muʿallaqa in Thaʿlab's recension. His wisdom verses on death and fate are classic shawāhid. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: ديوان الأعشى
note: Poems by al-Aʿshā. Note: one item is al-Tabrīzī's sharḥ of his Muʿallaqa, so skip that one.

title: ديوان الشنفرى - إلقاء سارة حسبو (كامل)
note: Al-Shanfarā's complete dīwān, including Lāmiyyat al-ʿArab: the ṣuʿlūk (outlaw) ethic of self-reliance. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: لامية العرب للشنفرى مسموعة مقروءة بإلقاء الشيخ عبد الرحمن الحمين
note: Lāmiyyat al-ʿArab in full in al-Ḥumayyin's voice, with the text on screen (7.5 min). The best single listen. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: قصيدة صوتية: لامية العرب للشنفرى [تسجيل جديد، مع شرح المفردات]
note: Lāmiyyat al-ʿArab recited with brief glosses of the hard words. A good bridge for gharīb.

title: ديوان عُروة بن الوَرد - إلقاء فاطمة حازم (كامل)
note: ʿUrwa b. al-Ward's complete dīwān; the generous ṣuʿlūk's ethic of wealth, honour and fate. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: ✅ديوان المفضليات | مسموعا | مع الأبيات✅
note: The Mufaḍḍaliyyāt, close to complete (130 items for c.126-130 poems), recited by Dr Muḥammad Surūr al-Najjār with the verses on screen. A full recitation does exist.

title: قراءة المفضليات - طه الأزهري
note: Ṭāhā al-Azharī reads the Mufaḍḍaliyyāt in order. A partial set (20 so far), with very careful iʿrāb.

title: ✅ديوان الأصمعيات | مسموعا | مع الأبيات✅
note: The Aṣmaʿiyyāt, mostly complete (78 items), recited with the verses on screen.

title: جمهرة أشعار العرب لأبي زيد القرشي
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: Abū Zayd al-Qurashī's Jamhara (the sumūṭ, mujamharāt and others), declaimed by Abū Qays. Jamhara's preface explicitly links poetry to the Qurʾān's language.

title: العوالي الجاهليّات
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: 199 jāhilī masterpieces declaimed by Abū Qays. Some items are 'evenings' (sahrāt) with brief appreciation between verses, so it is mixed.

title: قصائد حرب البسوس
note: Poems of the Basūs war, recited by al-Quḍāʿ: blood-vengeance (tha'r) and tribal honour, which the Qurʾān's qiṣāṣ answers. jahiliyya tradition not yet created.

title: عيون الشعر
note: Fāliḥ al-Quḍāʿ's large anthology covering all eras. Era set to jahili only because that is the lead; the list is mixed. Includes Ḥātim al-Ṭāʾī's 'Amāwiyya'.

title: قراءة ديوان الحماسة - طه الأزهري
note: Whole chapters (bāb al-ḥamāsa, marāthī, adab, nasīb, hijāʾ) of Abū Tammām's Ḥamāsa read in full, mostly jāhilī and early-Islamic poets.

title: ديوان الخنساء بصوت الأستاذة نور أحمد
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: Al-Khansāʾ's elegies for Ṣakhr and Muʿāwiya, read by Nūr Aḥmad. Short, but the only dedicated set.

title: أشعار صدر الإسلام 136 دقيقة 800 بيت
poet_en: Ḥassān b. Thābit, Kaʿb b. Zuhayr, al-Khansāʾ and others
note: Poetry of the early-Islamic period: four parts of Ḥassān selections read by ʿĀrif Ḥijjāwī, Bānat Suʿād and al-Khansāʾ by al-Quḍāʿ, and more.

title: سلسلة إنشاد المدائح النبوية
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
poet_en: Kaʿb b. Zuhayr, Abū Ṭālib, al-Nābigha al-Jaʿdī, al-Būṣīrī…
note: Declamation (no music) of Bānat Suʿād, Lāmiyyat Abī Ṭālib, al-Nābigha al-Jaʿdī's poem that mentions the Prophet, and al-Būṣīrī's Burda.

title: بانت سعاد- كعب بن زهير | إلقاء: أسامة الواعظ
note: Bānat Suʿād in full (about 10 min), in Usāma al-Wāʿiẓ's well-known recitation. The poem was recited before the Prophet.

title: عَفَتْ ذاتُ الأصابعِ - حسان بن ثابت رضي الله عنه - بصوت فالح القضاع
note: Ḥassān's Hamziyya, composed around the conquest of Mecca and answering Abū Sufyān; recited by al-Quḍāʿ (4 min).

title: جرير والفرزدق والأخطل
note: Poems by the three great Umayyad poets, including naqāʾiḍ (flyting poems). The only real recitation set found for them.

title: العوالي الإسلاميات
channel: قناة الأستاذ أبي قيس محمد رشيد للشعر العربي
note: 96 early-Islamic and Umayyad poems (Kuthayyir, Jamīl, Majnūn and ʿudhrī poets, Dhū al-Rumma and others), declaimed by Abū Qays.

title: أبو تمام بصوت أسامة النهاري
note: Abū Tammām's major odes, including 'al-Ḥaqqu ablaj', chanted in ḥudāʾ style by Usāma al-Nahārī.

title: البحتري بصوت أسامة النهاري
note: Al-Buḥturī's odes chanted by al-Nahārī. The Sīniyya ('Ṣuntu nafsī') is included.

title: ديوان المتنبي بصوت عبد المجيد مجذوب
note: 104 Mutanabbī poems in the classic voice of the actor ʿAbd al-Majīd Majdhūb. The largest Mutanabbī recitation set.

title: ديوان أبي فراس الحمداني
note: Abū Firās's poems, including captivity themes, read in order by Aḥmad Māhir.

title: أبو العلاء المعري
note: Al-Maʿarrī read by ʿAlī Ṭāhā al-Nūbānī, including 'Ghayru mujdin' and his elegy for his father. Sceptical and pessimist themes. No complete Luzūmiyyāt recitation exists.

title: شعر الزهد والحكمة
note: 75 zuhdiyyāt (renunciation poems) by Abū al-ʿAtāhiya, many in al-Ḥumayyin's voice. Plain language and Qurʾān-saturated: death, the dunyā, reckoning.

title: ألفية ابن مالك: إنشاد يوسف العيناتي
note: The full Alfiyya chanted by chapter (bāb), from the introduction onward, by Yūsuf al-ʿAynātī. The grammar poem as listening text.

title: متن الشاطبية بصوت د. أيمن سويد
note: Ḥirz al-Amānī (al-Shāṭibiyya) in full, by chapter, in Dr Ayman Suwayd's voice. A qirāʾāt poem, so it is listed under the quran strand.

title: البردة للامام البوصيري كاملة بفصولها العشرة احمد ويوسف المزرزع
note: The full Burda, all ten sections (57 min), by the al-Mazrūʿ brothers. Probably voice only, but music-free status not confirmed; for a short voice-only version, see Abū Qays's madāʾiḥ row.

title: لامية ابن الوردي - إلقاء أسامة الواعظ
note: Lāmiyyat Ibn al-Wardī in full (8.5 min), recited by Usāma al-Wāʿiẓ. Easy wisdom/advice poetry and good for building vocabulary.

title: نونية القحطاني بصوت القارئ فارس عباد
channel: همة حتى القمة Mettle to the top
note: The Nūniyya in themed sections in Fāris ʿAbbād's voice. It is Atharī creed polemic (against Ashʿarīs and Rāfiḍa), so read it as a worldview text. The poet's identity and dates are uncertain.
